edge_cases: each row normalized independently using ITS OWN mean/variance (gamma/beta shared per-column across rows, inv_lut shared but indexed per-row)
constant-value row (var=0, LUT index 0), max-variance row (alternating -128/127), first/last row
fully random per-element input so rows genuinely differ in statistics (defeats any global/cross-row confusion)
name: i8_layernorm_dma

params.formula: per-row integer LayerNorm: mu=trunc(sum/W), var=trunc(sum((x-mu)^2)/W), inv=inv_lut[clamp(var,0,255)], out=clamp(round((round((x-mu)*gamma,7)*inv,8))+beta)
